forum.title: CubeMX fails to generate Multimode Config call
forum.best_answer_content:
Hello ​@AQB

Your contribution is much appreciated.

Issue has been escalated to dev team under internal ticket ID **#0064101**

I will keep you posted with updates.

THX

Ghofrane
forum.content_text:
Using project setup from NUCLEO-U3C5ZI-Q, when ADC1>ADCs\_Common\_Settings>Mode is set to `Dual regular simultaneous mode only` CubeMX fails to generate the HAL\_ADCEx\_MultiModeConfigChannel() call to configure the ADCs for dual mode. This must be manually added by the user, otherwise the slave ADC does not trigger conversions. I believe this call was supposed to generate in MX\_ADC1\_Init. Am I missing something here?
